PassiveDesc.Name: The Black Silence
PassiveDesc.Desc: Has unique EGO pages and BGM. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: The Returner
PassiveDesc.Desc: Starts at Emotional Level 1. “Returner” triggers upon taking fatal damage, restores all HP and Stagger. “Returner” triggers up to the current emotion level. When “Returner” is triggered, max health value is increased by 20, max break value is increased by 10 and become invulnerable to status ailments. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: The Returner
PassiveDesc.Desc: Starts at Emotional Level 2. “Returner” triggers upon taking fatal damage, restores all HP and Stagger. “Returner” triggers up to the current emotion level. When “Returner” is triggered, max health value is increased by 50, max break value is increased by 30 and become invulnerable to status ailments. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Shimmering
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of each Scene, exhaust all pages in hand and deck; add new pages to hand. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Eternal Silence
PassiveDesc.Desc: Every 10 Scenes. Reduce 1 stack of Returner (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Perception-blocking Mask
PassiveDesc.Desc: A Speed die with the lowest Speed becomes untargetable (untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Black Gloves
PassiveDesc.Desc: All dice on the page selected in the 3rd Speed dice slot gain +3 Power. (untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Relentless Grudge
PassiveDesc.Desc: Recover 1-3 Stagger Resist or Recover 1-3 HP on hit (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Combo
PassiveDesc.Desc: All dice on every 5th Combat Page used gain +5 Power. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Revenge
PassiveDesc.Desc: Gain a Counter Slash dice (4-8; [On Clash Win] All dice on target's page lose 5 Power) at combat start. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: You Have to Try Harder than That!
PassiveDesc.Desc: Choose the Speed dice with the lowest value; the Speed values of the dice change to the maximum possible value. Boost the *maximum* roll value of all dice by +3. (Untransferable)

PassiveDesc.Name: Unstable Shackle
PassiveDesc.Desc: Take 1-5 extra Stagger Damage or Damage from all sources. Destroy this passive when Returner stacks is equal or above 3 (Untransferable)
